verdict.rationale: Snyk offers some bulk tooling — `/snyk-batch-fix` to address multiple issues at once, an agentic Remediation Agent that scans/fixes/verifies a whole project, and CLI/CI scans across full codebases — but community reports describe the automated bulk-PR fix workflow as low value, generating 'dozens or hundreds of PRs' that were eventually disabled in favor of Dependabot, undercutting the vendor's bulk-automation claims.
